name: COMP_009
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (60%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Flagged reliability (39%) [F6] and a split Benign–Invasive set [F1] support deferring frozen-section margin calls [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 60%, Benign 37%, InSitu 3%, Normal 0% | Leans invasive, high benign chance |
| Conformal set | Benign, Invasive (90% coverage, alpha 10%) | Cannot separate Benign from Invasive |
| Reliability / OOD | Reliability 39% (flagged), OOD 40th percentile | Suspect input; recut, levels drafted |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class | Independent foundation models split |
| Similar cases | 2/5 (40%) Invasive [F5]; 2 Benign, 1 InSitu | Weak reference neighbor consensus |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 2, 3, 6) · ↑ invasive · Strongest score (+1.36) toward invasion [F2]; AI spot-check 19/20 · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 2, 6, 10) · ↑ invasive · Unreliable score (+0.63) [F3]; failed AI spot-check (0/20), weak · Unreliable
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 2, 6, 11) · ↑ invasive · Nuclear atypia score (+0.40) [F4]; AI spot-check 18/20 · Validated
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 0) · ↓ invasive · Unreliable score (-0.37) opposing invasion; failed spot-check (0/20) · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 4, 5, 9) · ↓ invasive · Opposes invasion (-0.37); caption inconsistent, AI spot-check 18/20 · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions drops invasive score above random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 spans 0); uses unreliable mitoses (0/20), normal lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Frozen-section artifacts caused the 39% reliability flag; drafted recut H&E or deeper levels may clarify.
- Right-half tiles represent a benign mimic like BACH_0029 (88% similar), matching the 37% Benign probability.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 2, 3, 6, 10, 11**: Verify stromal invasion and pleomorphism; discount unreliable mitotic and necrosis scores.
2. **Regions 0, 4, 5, 9**: Confirm benign tubules and lymphocytes in the zero-risk left half.
3. **Regions 2, 3, 7, 10, 11**: Check superior, lateral, inferior margins; review drafted recut and deeper levels.
